headline: Approved minutes, motor vehicle excise tax abatements, and statutory exemption applications for August 2026
summary: The Board of Assessors approved minutes from a prior meeting, motor vehicle excise tax abatements, and statutory exemption applications including Clause 17E, 22, 22D, 22E, 41C, and a Senior Volunteer exemption. Some motor vehicle excise abatements and exemption applications were denied by signatures rather than by board vote.
decisions: Approved the minutes from August 11, 2026 meetings, unanimous.
Approved motor vehicle excise abatements for the week of August 3 to August 7 by signatures.

Approved statutory exemption applications for Clause 17E (3 applications), Clause 22 (4 applications), 22D (1 application), Clause 22E (4 applications), Clause 41C (3 applications), and 1 Senior Volunteer, unanimous.
Denied 2 statutory exemption applications by signatures.

decision_evidence.quote: R. Rondeau made a motion to approve the minutes, A. Lombardo 2nd – Unanimous.
Week of August 3 to August 7 – Approved by signatures
R. Rondeau made a motion to approve these applications, A. Lombardo 2nd – Unanimous.
